All Classes and Interfaces

Classes
Class
Description
BigHashMap<K,V>
A map based on a hash table, which uses a hash function to map keys to an array of values.
BigMap<K,V>
A custom implementation of a map, which associates unique keys with values, which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY entries, and which uses long integers to measure its BigMap.size().
BigNumberedMap<K extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered,V>
A map that uses numbered story graph elements as keys and stores values in an array list indexed by the key's ID number.
BigNumberedSet<N extends edu.uky.cs.nil.sg.Numbered>
A set of numbered story graph elements.
BigQueue<T>
A custom implementation of a first-in first-out queue which can hold up to Long.MAX_VALUE elements and which uses long integers to measure its BigQueue.size().
BigSet<T>
A custom implementation of a collection that does not allow duplicates which can hold up to BigArrayList.MAX_CAPACITY elements and which uses long integers to measure its BigSet.size().
BreadthFirstSearch
A task that performs a breadth-first search of a story graph, starting at node 0, and labeling each node based on the order in which it was visited by the search.
Clean
A story graph tool that is a combination of four other tools, which do the following tasks in this order: remove disconnected nodes, remove unused elements, remove duplicate elements, and sort all elements.
Entry<K,V>
An individual key/value pair in a map.
Explain
A story graph tool that generates explanations that will improve the author utility and that characters believe will improve their utility.
ExplanationPriorityQueue
A priority queue that stores explanation trees and pops them based on their plan length, from shortest to longest.
ExplanationTree
An object for building explanations by prepending temporal edges to the start of the sequence.
ExplanationTree.Branch
An explanation tree created by prepending a temporal edge to an existing explanation tree.
ExplanationTree.Root
An explanation tree that represents an explanation that ends at a node for a character.
Explore
A story graph tool that that prints a human-readable description of a story graph node to standard output and accepts directions from standard input that allow the user to visit other nodes and explore a story graph.
Generate
A tool that generates a story graph from a Sabre narrative planning problem.
GraphSnapshot
An object for printing summary statistics about a story graph before and after it has been modified.
NodeHashMap<V>
A hash map that uses nodes as keys, where two nodes are considered the same if their states are the same and, for each character, the beliefs of that character lead to nodes which are the same.
Option
An option that can be used to configure a story graph tool when passed as an argument.
PlanHashMap<V>
A hash map that uses plans as keys, where two plans are considered the same if they represent the same sequence of actions.
PlanTree
An object for building plans by prepending actions to the start of the sequence so that when duplicate plans are created the same object is reused to save memory.
PlanTree.Branch
A plan tree formed by prepending a single action to the start of an existing plan tree.
PlanTree.Root
The empty plan for a given story graph.
RemoveDisconnected
A story graph tool that removes all nodes from a story graph that cannot be reached via a path of temporal or epistemic edges from node 0.
RemoveDuplicates
A story graph tool that replaces duplicate elements in a story graph to save memory.
RemoveUnexplained
A story graph tool that removes temporal edges which are not explained for their consenting non-player characters.
RemoveUnused
A story graph tool that removes unused elements from a story graph.
ReplaceDuplicateNodes
A task that replaces duplicate nodes in a story graph.
ReplaceDuplicatePlans
A task that replaces duplicate plans in a story graph to save memory--the plans are considered the same if they are the same series of actions.
ReplaceDuplicateStates
A task that replaces duplicate states in a story graph to save memory--two states are considered the same if they assign the same values to all fluents and the same utility to the author and to each character.
SimpleStoryGraphTool
A parent class for story graph tools that reads a story graph from file, performs an operation on that graph, and then write the graph back out to file.
Sort
A story graph tool that sorts the symbols, nodes, and edges of a story graph.
SortExplanations
A task that sorts the explanations in a story graph based on the node they are associated with, the character forming the plan, and the plan being formed.
SortNodes
A task that sorts the nodes of a story graph based on the order they were visited during a breadth-first search starting at node 0.
SortPlans
A task that sorts the plans in a story graph to maximize the chances that a a tail plan will be created to save memory when reading the story graph's plans.
SortStates
A task that sorts the states of a story graph based on the first node that uses the state.
SortSymbols
A task that sorts a list of story graph symbols alphabetically by name.
StateHashMap<V>
A hash map that uses states as keys, where two states are considered the same if they return the same values for all fluents and return the same utility values for all characters.
StateMapping
A hash map that maps state graph nodes to their corresponding story graph state objects.
StoryGraphExplorer
A tool for tracking, describing, and changing the current node in a story graph.
StoryGraphGenerator
A tool for creating a story graph from a compiled Sabre problem.
StoryGraphTool
A parent class for story graph tools that provides some basic utilities for parsing command line arguments and printing help text.
ToolArguments
An object for parsing an array of string configuration arguments to a story graph tool, such as the command line arguments passed to a Java main method.
UnusedElementSearch
A breadth-first search task that marks story graph elements used as they are encountered, allowing any unused elements to be identified.
